info.title: Clearhire
info.summary: Explainable AI recruiting: requirement-level matching with evidence, blind screening and an audit trail.

schema.title: Response List Vacancies Api Vacancies Get

post.description: Draft requirements from a vacancy text, for the editor (nothing is saved).

schema.title: Response Parse Api Vacancies Parse Requirements Post

get.description:
Candidates for the vacancy, best first: fewest unmet must-haves, then requirement score, then
similarity. `pool` ranks everyone in the database, not only applicants (talent search).
Every requirement with its status, the reason, and the CV lines that show it.

post.description:
Add a candidate from their CV. Reading the CV happens in the background; the profile appears
when it is done (GET /api/candidates/{id}).

schema.title: Response List Candidates Api Candidates Get

get.description:
Hybrid search over CV passages: PostgreSQL full-text search (Russian and English) and pgvector
similarity, fused by reciprocal rank. Optional filters on skills and years of experience.

schema.title: Response Search Api Candidates Search Get

delete.description: Right to erasure (152-FZ art. 21), on the candidate's request to the recruiter.

get.description: The original file. Every download is written to the audit log.

post.description: Put an existing candidate into a vacancy's pipeline (from talent search).

schema.title: Response List Applications Api Applications Get

patch.description:
Move a candidate to another stage. Every move is kept for analytics and the audit log; the
candidate is told through their status page and, if they use it, the Telegram bot.

schema.title: Response Notes Api Applications  Application Id  Notes Get

get.description: Rebuild every anchored range from the log as it is now and compare it with the chain.
The Merkle proof that this entry is in an anchored period, checked by the contract itself.

schema.title: Response Audit Entries Api Audit Get

get.description: Recompute the whole hash chain. `valid: false` names the first entry that was changed.
The skill taxonomy, for the requirement editor's autocomplete.

schema.title: Response Vacancies Api Public Vacancies Get

post.description:
Check a CV against the vacancy before applying. The file is read in memory and nothing is kept, so
no consent is needed; the same matcher the recruiter uses gives the answer.
Apply with a CV. The answer carries a private token for the status page; keep it.

get.description: Where the application is, and the same requirement-by-requirement reading the recruiter sees.

delete.description: Withdraw consent: the candidate erases their applications, CV and profile themselves.

post.description:
A few sentences on the match, each citing its evidence. Kept until the requirements, the CV or the
model change; `refresh` writes a new one.
Answer a question about the candidate from their CV, citing the passages it used.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: the candidate agreed to processing of their personal data

CheckItem.title: CheckItem
CheckItem.description: One requirement, what was found in the candidate's own CV, and the lines that show it.

SourceOut.title: SourceOut
SourceOut.description: Something the assistant was shown and cited, exactly as it saw it (personal details redacted).
